

```{r env_setup}
library(napistu.r)

# configure path to venv & data
napistu_config = napistu.r::create_napistu_config(
    python_config = list(virtualenv = "~/Desktop/GITHUB/napistu/lib/napistu-scrapyard/scraps/pytorch/.venv"),
    assets_config = list(assets_dir = "~/Desktop/GITHUB/napistu/dev/human_consensus_no_rxns")
)

# load the SBML_dfs and NapistuGraph
napistu.r::setup_napistu_list(napistu_config)

# bind the Napistu Python package
napistu <- napistu_list$python_modules$napistu
```

```{r}
napistu <- napistu_list$python_modules$napistu
```

```{r}
top_component <- napistu$network$ig_utils$filter_to_largest_subgraphs(
    napistu_list$napistu_graph, top_k = 1L
)[[1]]
```
